import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartRange

/-! Reviewer probe (review-ajcr r7). ZERO modules in the tree import both the
Pic^0 chart seam and any `rep` producer, so no elaborator has ever seen the two
sides together. Question: does the producer's OUTPUT type match the seam's
`rep` BINDER -- i.e. do the two `divFunctor` carriers agree? -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
universe u

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]

-- One-index atlas at the SINGLE parameter `g` the producer returns at.
-- NOTE: the seam demands `ι : Type u`, so a `Unit`-indexed atlas does not
-- even typecheck; use a Type-u singleton.
variable (g : ℕ) {ι : Type u} (nn : ι → ℕ)

noncomputable example (D : ι → Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (rep : ∀ i, (divFunctor C pi (nn i)).RepresentableBy (D i))
    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (nn i : ℤ))
    (V : ∀ i, (D i).left.Opens)
    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
      (mixedParamChart C pi nn D rep m Z hdeg V i))
    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
      (Sigma.desc (mixedParamChart C pi nn D rep m Z hdeg V))] :
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
      (Over.mk ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
        (𝟙 (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued)).1) :=
  mixedParamRepresentableBy C pi nn D rep m Z hdeg V hf

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-! ## The carrier question, which the composition above does NOT answer.

Above, `rep` is a *hypothesis*. The real question is whether the term
`divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange` returns can be substituted for it:
its carrier is `divSchemeOver …`, the seam wants `D i : Over (Spec (.of k))`,
and the index must live in `Type u` while the producer returns at ONE `g`. -/

section CarrierJoin
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi] [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
variable [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral C.left]
variable [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
variable [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
variable [Module.Finite k ((Scheme.moduleKSheaf k C.left).HModule 0)]
variable [Module.Finite k ((Scheme.moduleKSheaf k C.left).HModule 1)]

/-- THE JOIN AT THE CARRIER: a PRODUCED `rep` (not a hypothesis) driving the
seam, over a `Type u` singleton index at the producer's single parameter `g`.
`repProduced` stands for the producer's output; `PUnit.{u+1}` is the index. -/
noncomputable example
    (g : ℕ) (D0 : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (repProduced : (divFunctor C pi g).RepresentableBy D0)
    (m0 : ℕ) (Z0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg0 : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z0
      = (m0 : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (g : ℤ))
    (V0 : D0.left.Opens)
    (hf : ∀ i : PUnit.{u+1}, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
      (mixedParamChart C pi (fun _ => g) (fun _ => D0) (fun _ => repProduced)
        (fun _ => m0) (fun _ => Z0) (fun _ => hdeg0) (fun _ => V0) i))
    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
      (Sigma.desc (mixedParamChart C pi (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => g) (fun _ => D0)
        (fun _ => repProduced) (fun _ => m0) (fun _ => Z0) (fun _ => hdeg0)
        (fun _ => V0)))] :
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
      (Over.mk ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
        (𝟙 (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued)).1) :=
  mixedParamRepresentableBy C pi (fun _ => g) (fun _ => D0) (fun _ => repProduced)
    (fun _ => m0) (fun _ => Z0) (fun _ => hdeg0) (fun _ => V0) hf

end CarrierJoin
